explication: Excalidraw is a hand-drawn-style whiteboard editor, with a reusable editor package and a showcase web app. The principal workflow is user interaction with the editor canvas, updating a diagram, then saving locally or exporting/sharing it; collaboration synchronizes room state and files. The README documents major editor capabilities, including image and library support, localization, undo/redo, and export. Some feature paths are represented by their source directories because their implementation was not sampled; edges are limited to README statements and indexed or excerpted references.
